summary: Preserve live-integrator metadata-cache corruption and I/O diagnostics instead of treating every Git check failure as a stale patch.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Metadata cache regeneration is limited to recognized Git patch-applicability diagnostics. Corrupt patches, unreadable entries, mixed or unknown diagnostics fail the tick without replacing the entry; Git failures include stdout and stderr. Only the applicability check forces C-locale messages so inherited language settings cannot prevent stale-cache recovery.

downtime.detail: The previous immutable build continues serving when metadata preparation fails.

manual.detail: Deploy the updated integrator helper. Investigate preserved corruption or I/O diagnostics before repairing or removing an invalid cache entry; ordinary stale patches still regenerate automatically.

recovery.detail: Roll forward with a repaired or removed invalid cache entry after resolving the reported cause. Rolling back the helper restores broader regeneration fallback without changing the cache format.
